notes: Every update now carries a version label: the date plus a running number, shown on the sign-in screen, the show page footer and the printed call sheet.
Fixed Add cue: new cues were being saved but not showing up on screen.
Link a day to a public Google Sheet. The Google Sheet button reads cue names, lengths, presenters, notes and crew columns, and refreshes by itself about every 30 seconds.
Crew columns such as Audio, Video and Lighting become notes for the matching crew positions.
New Update button in the top right corner. Green means you're on the newest version. Yellow means an update is ready.
Clicking the yellow button shows what's new before you update.
